abbeygate-england.title: Your Brand, Our Craftsmanship — Bespoke Corporate Gifting
abbeygate-england.prose_html:
About Project

Abbeygate England (under PUP Exports) is an internationally recognized artisan manufacturer of bespoke leather merchandise, corporate diaries, executive notebooks, and custom-embossed accessories. Catering to prestigious corporate clients, multinational enterprises, and luxury institutions across the United Kingdom, Europe, and worldwide, their hallmark is uncompromising artisanal precision, hand-stitched detailing, and refined material quality.

To translate this multi-decade heritage of British craftsmanship into an impactful digital flagship, we designed and engineered an elevated B2B corporate gifting platform and interactive digital showroom. The primary objective was to replace traditional static catalogues and fragmented PDF brochures with an agile, high-converting digital experience tailored specifically for corporate procurement directors, brand marketing managers, and executive gifting coordinators.

The platform introduces interactive real-time personalization, enabling prospective clients to simulate blind debossing, metallic foil stamping (in gold, silver, and rose-gold finishes), and personalized corporate monograms across premium leather folios, executive portfolios, and custom-bound diaries. Paired with high-resolution material libraries showcasing genuine Italian full-grain leather, sustainable vegan alternatives, and bespoke edge-stitching variations, the digital showroom empowers enterprise decision-makers to make confident bulk purchasing decisions.

Complementing the visual experience is an intelligent B2B volume quotation engine that allows procurement leads to configure batch tiers, request sample kits, and receive itemized quotations with zero friction. The entire architecture is built on a responsive, performance-optimized foundation, ensuring sub-second load times and flawless usability whether accessed from a desktop workstation or an executive mobile device on the go.

Features

Bespoke Customizer & Foil Previews

Interactive tool allowing corporate clients to preview custom blind debossing, metallic foil stamping, and personalized corporate branding across leather folios and executive notebooks.

Curated Material & Texture Showcase

High-resolution material gallery exhibiting genuine Italian leather grains, sustainable vegan alternatives, tailored stitch patterns, and bespoke color swatches.

Instant B2B Volume Quotations

Streamlined procurement portal enabling corporate buyers and gifting coordinators to configure batch quantities, custom packaging, and dispatch quote requests in seconds.

Fluid Cross-Device Experience

Ultra-fast mobile and desktop architecture engineered for seamless performance, crisp typography, and rapid catalog browsing across any screen.

Results

+180% increase in corporate B2B inquiries
3.2x faster catalog browsing & quotation requests

electro-core-systems.title: Empowering Communication. Connecting the Future.
electro-core-systems.prose_html:
About Project

Electro Core Systems is an enterprise technology provider delivering advanced structured computer networking, IP telephony, commercial CCTV surveillance, access control, and smart IoT automation. They design, deploy, and maintain mission-critical communications backbones and industrial security infrastructures for multinational corporations, academic institutions, healthcare facilities, and manufacturing plants across India.

As Electro Core Systems expanded its operations into large-scale fiber-optic deployments and industrial IoT architectures, their digital presence required a comprehensive architectural overhaul. We partnered with their engineering leadership to develop a technology-forward, authoritative web platform that clearly communicates their engineering scale, technical certifications, and enterprise service capabilities to CTOs, IT directors, and infrastructure procurement teams.

The resulting platform features interactive network topology blueprints, modular security breakdown portals, certified hardware compliance libraries, and an enterprise project estimation funnel. Engineered for high performance with sub-second page delivery across complex schematics, the website positions Electro Core Systems as an indispensable digital infrastructure partner for resilient, future-ready enterprise operations.

Features

Structured Network Topology Visualizer

Interactive blueprints showcasing fiber-optic backbones, server rack configurations, switchboards, and enterprise routing setups.

Enterprise Security & Surveillance Hub

Detailed architectural breakdowns for multi-site commercial CCTV monitoring, biometric access gates, and automated intrusion detection.

Dedicated IT Consultation Funnel

Streamlined inquiry pipeline customized for CTOs, IT managers, and enterprise procurement leads to submit technical RFPs directly.

High-Speed Technical Specification Engine

Instant access to certified equipment spec sheets, compliance documentation, and 24/7 SLA maintenance tier breakdowns.

Results

+210% increase in enterprise infrastructure inquiries
< 1.2s average page load speed across all network service guides

udbhav-developers.title: Exclusive Club House Generations & Premium Living
udbhav-developers.prose_html:
About Project

Udbhav Developers is an innovative real estate development and architectural firm crafting iconic lifestyle destinations, resort-style clubhouses, and sustainable residential communities. Their developments combine modern luxury architectural design with community-centric living, biophilic landscaping, and environmentally conscious green building principles.

To capture the experiential grandeur of their premier residential towers and sprawling resort clubhouses, we crafted an immersive, cinematic digital property showcase. Traditional real estate listings and flat PDF floorplans often fail to evoke the emotional pride of homeownership; our solution bridges that gap with high-definition virtual tours, interactive master plans, and detailed architectural amenities galleries.

Prospective homebuyers and luxury investors can seamlessly explore unit floorplans with real-time room dimension overlays, examine sun-path and orientation indicators, and inspect recreational facilities ranging from rooftop infinity pools to wellness studios. With an integrated one-click WhatsApp VIP booking concierge and instant weekend site visit scheduler, the platform turns curiosity into high-intent on-site visits with exceptional conversion velocity.

Features

Clubhouse & Amenity Showcase

Cinematic visuals and galleries highlighting infinity pools, wellness spas, landscaped rooftop gardens, and premium club lounges.

Interactive Masterplans & Unit Floorplans

High-definition floor plans with room dimensions, orientation indicators, and downloadable PDF architectural brochures.

Instant VIP Site Visit Booking

One-tap booking modal and direct WhatsApp integration allowing prospective homeowners to schedule weekend visits effortlessly.

Strategic Connectivity & Neighborhood Map

Dynamic location maps showing travel times to premier tech corridors, international schools, metro stations, and healthcare hubs.

Results

+165% surge in private site visit bookings
85% increase in average session duration exploring master plans

the-laptop-bazar.title: Next-Gen Tech Hardware & E-Commerce Platform
the-laptop-bazar.prose_html:
About Project

The Laptop Bazar is a high-volume technology retailer and enterprise hardware procurement provider offering certified laptops, gaming workstations, enterprise computers, and premium peripherals with comprehensive warranty protection and post-sales technical support.

In the competitive computing hardware and certified refurbished market, buyer confidence is paramount. Customers—ranging from individual software developers and competitive gamers to startups equipping entire engineering teams—demand absolute transparency regarding component specifications, cosmetic grading, battery health, and warranty guarantees. We re-engineered The Laptop Bazar's digital ecosystem into a high-velocity, trust-first e-commerce destination.

The platform features lightning-fast real-time filtering across processor architectures (Intel Core, AMD Ryzen, and Apple Silicon), dedicated graphics cards, RAM configurations, and price brackets. Multi-point inspection certificates and transparent condition badges are prominently integrated into every product page, complemented by an instant B2B bulk fleet quotation calculator and direct WhatsApp technical advisory bridges with experienced hardware engineers.

Features

Precision Specification Filtering

Real-time filtering across processor architectures (Intel Core/Ryzen/Apple M-series), dedicated GPUs, RAM, SSD capacity, and price bands.

Certified Quality Grading & Warranty

Transparent cosmetic and functional grading reports paired with verified warranty badges for total consumer peace of mind.

B2B Enterprise Fleet Procurement

Custom bulk quotation engine enabling startups and corporations to configure and deploy hardware fleets seamlessly.

Instant WhatsApp Hardware Advisory

Direct connectivity to experienced hardware technicians for immediate compatibility checks and configuration recommendations.

Results

+190% boost in direct online catalog inquiries and orders
-38% drop in cart abandonment with streamlined checkout flow

venture-chess-academy.title: Mastering the Board — Strategic Coaching Hub
venture-chess-academy.prose_html:
About Project

Venture Chess Academy is a premier international chess coaching academy founded by FIDE-rated coaches, International Masters, and Grandmasters. They offer structured online and in-person coaching, competitive tournament preparation, and cognitive strategic development programs for students ranging from young novices to internationally ranked competitive athletes.

Operating across multiple continents and international time zones required a centralized, intellectually engaging digital hub that appeals equally to enthusiastic young learners and discerning parents. We designed and built an interactive learning portal that communicates the rigor of grandmaster-designed curriculums while simplifying enrollment, time-slot scheduling, and student progress tracking.

The platform features interactive curriculum progression pathways mapped from beginner fundamentals to advanced tactical calculation, an automated timezone-aware calendar booking engine for free evaluation sessions, and a prestigious Tournament Victory Hall celebrating national championships, FIDE rating milestones, and international accolades. Optimized for seamless access on both desktop and mobile, parents worldwide can effortlessly schedule classes and track their child's chess journey.

Features

Rating-Calibrated Learning Tracks

Tailored curriculum paths categorized from foundational opening tactics (0–1200) to master-level endgame calculation (1800+).

Automated Global Trial Class Booking

Timezone-synchronized booking calendar allowing parents across Europe, the US, and Asia to schedule evaluation games instantly.

Tournament Victories & Hall of Fame

Interactive celebration of student trophies, national championship medals, and international FIDE rating milestones.

Grandmaster Faculty Credentials

Transparent coaching directory showcasing FIDE Master achievements, coaching pedagogies, and tournament records.

Results

+240% growth in international student academy enrollments
4.9★ average rating across over 500+ student and parent reviews

one-more-rep-gym.title: High-Impact Fitness & Training Community Experience
one-more-rep-gym.prose_html:
About Project

One More Rep Gym is an elite fitness and high-performance strength training facility known for intense functional workouts, certified personal training, state-of-the-art Olympic lifting rigs, and an empowering, supportive athletic community.

While the physical atmosphere inside the gym was electric, vibrant, and packed with high energy, their previous web presence was static and understated. We engineered a bold, high-octane digital identity that radiates the intensity of physical training, captures the camaraderie of the gym floor, and motivates prospective athletes to take immediate action.

The platform features a frictionless two-tap digital guest pass generator that lets first-time visitors claim a free day pass with instant QR verification. Members enjoy real-time interactive class timetables for CrossFit, HIIT, strength circuits, and personal training sessions, alongside clear, transparent membership tier breakdowns with zero hidden fees. With inspirational transformation spotlights and high-definition facility walk-throughs, the site stands as the region's top destination for fitness excellence.

Features

Instant Day Pass Generator

Two-tap digital pass booking allowing first-time athletes to instantly generate and verify a complimentary gym workout pass.

Live Workout & Trainer Schedules

Interactive daily timetables for CrossFit, Olympic weightlifting, HIIT, and personal training sessions with one-touch registration.

Transparent Tiered Memberships

Comprehensive breakdown of flexible monthly, quarterly, and annual passes with zero hidden registration fees.

Member Transformation Hall

Inspirational before-and-after spotlights with trainer commentary, training regimes, and nutritional coaching advice.

Results

+175% increase in membership sign-ups & day pass bookings
92% mobile engagement rate among members checking class schedules

wilderness.title: Optimising conversion without compromising luxury
wilderness.prose_html:
Client

Wilderness Safaris offers premium travel to some of the world’s most remote and breathtaking locations. They combine raw, natural experiences with all the comfort and luxury travellers could want.

Results

+144% increase in enquiry rate
-46% reduction in cost per acquisition

Challenge

Despite a beautifully designed website that reflected the brand’s luxury positioning, paid media campaigns were costing far too much. The site wasn’t converting visitors into enquiries efficiently, resulting in an unsustainable cost per acquisition.

Approach

We redesigned user journeys across the site to make them smoother and more intuitive. Stunning visuals and clear layouts guided visitors naturally, presenting calls to action at the right moments - all while maintaining the brand’s luxurious look and feel.

bbd-boom.title: Fully integrated design support for a high-volume Hubspot agency
bbd-boom.prose_html:
Client

BBD Boom helps businesses get more from HubSpot through tailored CRM strategies and bespoke implementation. As a highly accredited partner, they work with organisations across a range of sectors, supporting teams to use the platform in a way that genuinely fits how they operate. Alongside delivery, they share practical insight and thought leadership to help their clients build confidence and get lasting value from HubSpot.

Results

BBD Boom produces a high volume of content, from marketing assets and thought leadership to events. Using our flexible, credit-based design support, they’ve been able to build real momentum and sustain a level of output that wasn’t previously possible.

Projects now move from brief to completion in a matter of days, freeing up internal resource and giving the marketing team more capacity to focus on what matters most.

Challenge

BBD Boom wanted to level up their marketing and increase their output of insightful content, but limited resource and capacity were holding them back. Projects often sat in a queue, slowing momentum and reducing flexibility.
Hiring an in-house designer felt like a costly option, and in reality, BBD Boom needed access to a broader creative skillset.

Approach

The approach was simple: use flexible design support to tap into the expertise of an entire creative team. Working through a streamlined, credit-based system, the process reduces admin and keeps everything moving efficiently.
All of this is managed through an intuitive dashboard, where tasks are tracked and everyone has clear visibility.

roswell.title: A bold new identity for a Shopify Platinum Partner
roswell.prose_html:
About Project

Roswell NYC is an award-winning Shopify Platinum Partner based in the United States. Working in partnership with globally recognized lifestyle and direct-to-consumer brands, they have established themselves as an industry benchmark in enterprise ecommerce engineering, headless storefront architectures, and high-conversion UX design.

Following years of successful collaborative partnerships, we were commissioned to elevate Roswell's digital flagship experience to match their elite reputation in the Shopify ecosystem. The challenge was to balance daring, kinetic visual design with ultra-fast technical performance, creating an experience that serves both as an engaging creative showcase and as undeniable proof of technical mastery for enterprise prospective clients.

We designed and implemented a modular, motion-rich site architecture featuring bespoke micro-interactions, scroll-driven interactive case study breakdowns, and comprehensive technical teardowns highlighting conversion rate lifts and headless performance gains. The new platform communicates Roswell's creative depth and engineering prowess with absolute clarity, solidifying their standing among the top echelon of global ecommerce agencies.

Features

Kinetic Agency Storytelling

Fluid micro-interactions and scroll-reactive animations highlighting creative and engineering depth without sacrificing performance.

Enterprise Case Study Showcase

Modular storytelling layouts featuring conversion metrics, technical stack architecture, and custom Shopify Plus app features.

Headless High-Performance Architecture

Sub-second page navigation and optimized media assets designed for enterprise client engagement and seamless international browsing.

Interactive Client Roster

Curated portfolio directory showcasing global DTC brands, brand repositioning strategies, and revenue growth achievements.

Results

  • Drastically reduced time required to deliver distinct webpages
  • Increased responsiveness and performance across all mobile & desktop viewports
  • Substantial lift in inbound enterprise client inquiries

solent-rib-charter.title: Modernising a group of sites for a marine services provider
solent-rib-charter.prose_html:
Client

Solent Rib Charter operate a number of water-based businesses across the UK and Europe. Their sub-brand sites needed a refresh, while maintaining a consistent look and feel.

Results

  • Drastically reduced time required to deliver distinct webpages
  • Increased responsiveness and performance across devices

Challenge

Each sub-brand had unique requirements, so the challenge  was to design versatile page sections that could adapt to varying content.

Approach

Breaking key pages into modular components allowed us to build a shared design system. With each brand’s styling applied, the experience remained recognisable, consistent, and cohesive.
